ZAMEEN NORD (SMC-PRIVATE) LIMITED
NOTES TO THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS
FOR THE YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2023
1

COMPANY AND ITS OPERATIONS

1.1

Corporate and General Information
Zameen Nord (SMC-Private) Limited ("the Company") was incorporated on 26 November 2020 as a Single Member
Company under the Companies Act (The Act). The Company's principal activity is to engage in the business of
development of all types of real estate including commercial markets and multi-storey buildings, shopping centers etc.
The registered office of the Company is situated at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road Gulberg III, Lahore. The
Company is a subsidiary of Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited ("the Parent Company"), a Company incorporated
in Pakistan. The ultimate parent of the Company is Dubizzle Group Holdings Limited (formerly known as EMPG
Holdings Limited), a Company incorporated in United Arab Emirates (UAE).

1.2

The Company holds 50% share in TFZD (the Firm), a partnership firm which was established on 16 August 2021 in
Pakistan. The firm was registered with the Registrar of Firms under section 58 (I) of the Partnership Act, 1932 on 06
November 2021. Its primary place of business and registered office is located at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road
Gulberg III, Lahore. The principal activity of the Firm is to undertake, manage, market and sell the project, TFZD on
the land located in Islamabad. As at 30 June 2023, the project has not yet started.
The Company has incurred loss of Rs. 32,922,700 (2022: Rs. 15,190,845) and its accumulated losses as at the
reporting date amounts to Rs. 48,284,695 (2022: Rs. 15,361,995) resulting in a negative equity of Rs. 48,284,685
(2022: Rs. 15,361,985) as at that date. The Parent Company has committed to provide financial support to the
Company, enabling the Company to continue its operations as going concern and fulfil all of its financial obligation.
Based on which the financial statements of the Company are prepared on going concern basis.

2

BASIS OF PREPARATION

2.1

Statement of compliance
These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the accounting and reporting standards as
applicable in Pakistan. The accounting and reporting standards applicable in Pakistan comprise of:
- International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS Standards) issued by the International Accounting Standards
Board (IASB) as notified under the Companies Act, 2017; and
- Provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017.
Where provisions of and directives issued under the Companies Act, 2017 differ from the IFRS standards, the
provisions of and directives of the Companies Act, 2017 have been followed.

2.2

Basis of measurement
These financial statements have been prepared under the historical cost convention unless otherwise stated.

2.3

Functional and presentation currency
These financial statements are presented in Pak Rupees, which is the Company’s functional currency. All figures have
been rounded off to the nearest Rupee, unless otherwise stated.

2.4

Standards, interpretations and amendments to published accounting standards
The accounting policies adopted are consistent with those of the previous financial period, except for the following
new and amended standards and interpretations effective for annual period beginning on January 01, 2022, as listed
below:

2.4.1

New Standards, Interpretations and Amendments effective in the reporting period
The accounting policies adopted in the preparation of these financial statements are consistent with those of the
previous financial year, except for following amendments to accounting standards which are effective for annual
periods beginning on or after July 01, 2022 (unless otherwise stated).
IFRS 3

Business Combinations – The amendment updates a reference in IFRS 3 to the Conceptual
Framework for Financial Reporting without changing the accounting requirements for business
combinations.
